name: Epii / Antichrist — Episode 1.1: the QL units
description: The seven manifest-admitted QL units of episode 1.1, one scene per record in the records' own dependency order: parent, recognised structure, physical image, political expression, occlusion, and the two spectral enactments. Source: antichrist-vault (EpiLogos/research-canvas) at 7df35f822f9235331a69940cdaf484fe4a0b95c1, admitted by antichrist-vault/knowledge-manifest.json (schemaVersion 1, contentRevision 2). Scene texts carry faithful compression and verbatim phrases; all tints, layouts and forces are declared presentation mappings, not source claims. Per-scene source bindings with sha256 live in bindings/epii-ep1-ql-units.binding.json. Corpus: epii-antichrist.

scenes.name: Self-Identity — the parent node
scenes.character: Not a position within any unit, but the generative source of all the units.

text.title: Self-Identity
text.body: Identical to / for / as / with itself — four modalities of self-relation, each opening a register. The copula "I am" is aham vimarśa: the self-recognition that IS the creative pulse. The abstract labels describe; the name generates.

scenes.name: The ontological unit — Truth → Image of Truth
scenes.character: The metaphysical face of QL — the topology of how consciousness becomes world.

text.title: Truth → Image of Truth
text.body: From the irrepresentable ground through Mind, Word and Logos to the personal Son and the world as Image. Psychic facticity is the ground experienced phenomenologically: the psyche produces facts. The dynamic of naming IS the whole unit in action.

scenes.name: The solar system — the physical image
scenes.character: An ecology of interdependencies, all sustained by one source.

text.title: The Solar System
text.italic: the master image of the series
text.body: Everything in the system IS the sun in some essential sense — the source gives itself completely into forms that no longer resemble it. A redwood tree IS the sun, but looks nothing like the sun. Simultaneously scientific fact and archetypal structure.

scenes.name: The social / power unit — Play → Work
scenes.character: Self-Identity experienced politically — the copula rendered as a social and political dynamic.

text.title: Play → Work
text.italic: the exercising and exorcising of power
text.body: The exercising of power is the relation between Work and Play. The greater the self-identification, the greater the harmony; the more the source is occluded, the more the One is imposed on the Many as domination. The politics IS the metaphysics experienced as "what am I?"

scenes.name: The deficiency unit — Black Sun, Clouded Sky
scenes.character: The same six positions under occlusion — the medium between source and receiver opaque.

text.title: Deficiency / Black Sun
text.body: Same structure, different experiential register: the sun still there, the system still structured, but the medium between source and receiver opaque. What the deficiency occludes, the solar unit gives as image; the power unit gives as political symptom.

scenes.name: The spectral Devil's chain — the Antagonist
scenes.character: Self-Identity playing against itself — the one whose role is to scatter, fragment, contract identity.

text.title: The Devil's Sixfold
text.body: No single image exhausts the Devil; every portrait is a harmonic of the same fundamental. The direction of sacrifice is the single diagnostic — here inward, toward the centre. Arc: from unnamed shadow toward Pan — the recognition that matter itself is sacred.

scenes.name: The spectral Christ's chain — the Protagonist
scenes.character: Self-Identity playing as itself — the one who gathers, restores, brings the fragments home.

text.title: The Christ's Sixfold
text.italic: the giving that increases what it gives to
text.body: Still sacrifice — but the direction of flow is consistently outward, toward life, toward the many. "The loaves and the fishes, where what is given multiplies in the giving." Whitehead's concrescence: the many become one and are increased by one. Arc: toward God-Man.
